role: The inventory interface every GUI inventory, tile entity inventory and the player's inventory implements: size, get/set/decr, the stack limit, the change notification and useability.

members.name: setInventorySlotContents
members.note: including the chest/furnace count clamp against the limit

members.name: onInventoryChanged
members.note: Each implementation's side effects where vanilla has them (the crafting grid recompute, the merchant's recipe reset, a tile entity's markDirty with no state beyond the save); InventoryBasic's listener list serves only horses (world.conf horses = off).

members.name: isUseableByPlayer
members.note: every block-backed inventory's test (same tile, within 8) in gui_can_interact

members.name: openInventory
members.note: most bodies are empty; the GUI opens live in survival.c's block-activation paths

members.name: isItemValidForSlot
members.note: for the four ported slot kinds; the tile-entity inventories' answers are not individually verified

notes: The tile entity inventories (chest, furnace, dispenser, hopper, ender chest) mirror the same interface with their own slot arrays in tileentity.c; the container-side port is struct inv. lane/idxblocks: the window titles are client GUI text, drawn by the screen renderer from the window kind (the gui_chest goldens), so the name members stay n/a.
